_description: Known-good Anthropic OAuth request protocol as implemented by Anvil. Compare mitmproxy captures against this file to detect protocol drift.
_source: Captured from Claude Code CLI v2.1.181 via mitmproxy.

auth_oauth._note: When using OAuth tokens (sk-ant-oat01-...), send as Authorization: Bearer. Capture from v2.1.143 used x-api-key with a regular API key — unclear if OAuth tokens also moved to x-api-key. Verify with an OAuth-only capture.

must_not_send._note: x-api-key must not be present when using OAuth Bearer auth.
must_not_send.x-api-key: Deleted when using OAuth Bearer auth.

beta_flags._note: Flags are comma-separated in the anthropic-beta header. Order does not matter. oauth-2025-04-20 is present on OAuth requests but absent from API key requests. Informational flags are known but not required — Anvil does not need to send them.

billing_header.position: First system message (prepended before all others).
billing_header.hash_input: SHA-256 of system prompt text + salt + CLI version.

identity_prefix.text: You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK.

stainless_headers_observed._note: These are set by the Anthropic SDK, not by application code. Listed for reference only.
